title: PinPin takes his bath
beat: Older boy bath, baby waits dry
staging: Mama washcloth left; PinPin tub; baby dry right
alt: PinPin bath with Mama and baby watching

references.role: Established nook geometry and corrected baby age

prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One polished 1536x1024 landscape storybook illustration, no text, no collage. Match the references' warm dimensional textured rendering, substantial curved timber architecture, chestnut quills, cream faces, small dark noses and restrained tender expressions. Exactly three hedgehogs: Mama largest; older-boy PinPin 60% Mama height at same depth; tiny baby PomPom only 55% PinPin height. Natural SHORT animal forelegs and paws, two forelimbs and two hindlimbs per animal, no clothes except specified cream towels. No extra animals or Beaver, no duplicate bodies or limbs. Reference image 1 fixes this bathing nook's actual geometry: ONE low oval wooden bath tub on oval woven mat in center, small round blue-dusk window back-left, simple wooden washstand with ceramic basin on far-left wall, cream towels on wooden rail on RIGHT wall, amber light. Preserve these same furnishings and their relations while shifting the camera. Reference image 2 is only for the three characters' facial identities and age difference. PinPin takes his bath. Move camera a little closer and to the right for a three-quarter view across the same tub. PinPin alone sits in shallow clear water, his recognizable older boy head and upper body well above rim, forepaws relaxed at rim, smiling quietly. Mama kneels at left side of tub and gently washes his quills using one small folded washcloth. Tiny baby PomPom waits visibly OUTSIDE the tub on a dry part of mat at right; baby is much smaller than PinPin. Mama has two short forepaws, one washcloth paw and other lightly resting on near rim. Two boys only, one in bath and baby on dry mat. Soft ripples, calm care. Baby must read as only HALF the older boy's full standing height, with half-size head. Remove the pouring pitcher from Mama's paws; it now rests beside washstand.
review: Selected after full inspection. Older PinPin alone in same tub, Mama washcloth at quills, baby outside on dry mat at right and visibly tiny. Mother two short forepaws readable. Two child forepaws at water surface; underwater attachments cannot be verified. Geography and stripe towels retained. Shot closer than08 but modest camera shift.
